data.body:
OCCURRENCE: posting 'recheck-review' on Gerrit change 1577 CANCELLED the in-flight CI run.

Timeline (change 1577, patch set 3):
  02:14:40  rebar CI bot: Patch Set 3: -Verified  STARTED: .../actions/runs/31349238794
  02:15:07  me: 'recheck-review' comment
  02:15:32  rebar CI bot: Patch Set 3: Code-Review-1 Verified-1  CANCELLED: .../31349238794

Net effect: the review was NOT retriggered (bug b0f5 — fire-and-forget queue) and a healthy CI
run was killed, leaving a Verified -1 that reflected the cancellation rather than any real
failure. Triaging that took a full cycle to attribute, because a cancellation and a genuine
failure present identically as Verified -1.
